title: Reconstitution of Long Random DNA fragments
body:
Nucleosome Reconstitution

lig50K - 5676 ng (in 13.5 uL) ==> 8.75 nM DNA (in 25 uL mixture)
*NOTE: Taking 40 kb as the mean size of the fragments, instead of 50 kb*

*Octamer:DNA ratio = 200:1*

WT Octamer (5.4 mg/mL) → 1.75 uM → 4.8 ug (0.8 uL of stock) 

⇒ Prepare a 1 ug/uL stock of octamer (6 uL) [1.1 stock + 4.9 uL refolding buffer:glycerol]

Octamer stock salt conc = 1.18 M

=> Add 5 uL of octamer stock to DNA already added to salt (1.84 M salt in octamer-DNA mix)

First incubate the dialysis column in cold NF-water to remove any glycerol from the column.

Add the 25 uL of octamer-DNA mix to the dialysis column and place in high salt RB and then perform dialysis O/N.

*Low salt RB (2 L)*

| Reagent | Volume |
| :---- | :---- |
| KCl | 37.28 g |
| 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 7.5) | 20 mL  
| 0.5 M EDTA | 4 mL |
| 1 M DTT | 2 mL |
